found_by: scripts/local_gate.py cross-arm discipline check on its rerun AFTER the echoed-signature fix - an instrument built to check instruments
mechanism: CROSS-ARM CERTIFICATION LEAK, a failure mode DISTINCT from the fixture-vs-reality family: q38field_score.py's certification gated on CONFIG markers only (served model present, effort token absent, graft markers absent, infra signatures absent). The private-base artifact is a SUPERSET composition - it carries every marker the simpler field-floor arm requires - so the certifier CERTIFIED another arm's artifact and emitted a cross-arm verdict (SIGNAL +0.427 on private_base_v1, an artifact whose numbers belong to a different arm's seal). Left unfixed it would silently attribute another arm's results to the field floor in any pull-dir mixup or automated sweep.
fix: Identity must be asserted POSITIVELY and NEGATIVELY: ARM_IDENTITY_REQUIRED ('anim-20260807' - the arm's own harness bundle marker) + ARM_IDENTITY_FORBIDDEN ('PRIVATE-ARM BANNER', 'model-20260815-q38-p1'). Verified against real artifacts both ways: q38_field_v1 certifies (SIGNAL 28 = the sealed record); private_base_v1 REFUSES on identity. Selftest green with real-shaped fixtures; local_gate --arm q38-field PASS 38/0.
cross_references: The four fixture-key instances (q38-low gate 08-17; graft scorer CLI-JSON 08-19; incoming private scorer games/game_runs + actions/score keys 08-21/22; q38field echoed-signature 08-22) are all 'fixtures diverge from reality'. THIS row is different: the reader matched reality fine - it matched TOO MUCH of it. Marker-subset certification is the dual defect: fixture drift makes a certifier refuse truth; marker-subset gating makes it accept falsehood.
lesson: A certifier that gates on config markers alone will certify any SUPERSET composition as its own arm. Every arm certifier must assert arm IDENTITY with at least one marker unique to the arm (required) and one marker unique to each richer sibling (forbidden). Corollary: when a new richer arm is created, every EXISTING certifier gains a forbidden marker for it - added to the local_gate corpus so the check is mechanical.
why_informative: Zero draws and zero verdicts were harmed - the leak was caught by the gate before any cross-arm read entered a sealed record - but the counterfactual is concrete: any automated sweep reading pull dirs with this certifier would have attributed private-arm numbers to the field floor. Registered as its own class so future certifier reviews check identity gating, not just fixture realism. The gate's first live rerun paid for it: an instrument built to check instruments found a defect class none of the four prior incidents exhibited.
